requirements.note: Central bachelor equivalent and GPA3/B. Direct QBio applicants must contact faculty before applying and have an adviser willing to mentor. BBSP entrants may join after first-year rotations. GRE optional, if supplied within five years and considered holistically. Recommendation count not established on opened sources.

funding.note: Undated QBio minimum $23,000 for nine months, pending funding availability and good standing; varies with adviser/source. TA/RA/fellowship; university support limited ten semesters. Assistantship/fellowship includes full tuition, mandatory fees and health insurance; summer support must be discussed. No universal international guarantee established.
